title: Affine raw module-cohomology classes have stage representatives after comparison
statement: Under the scheme, coefficient, cofiltered-index, affine-transition, qcqs, and limiting-cone assumptions of [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions], let U be an affine etale object over S [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For each raw degree-q class z in the derived-Hom presheaf of the limit with coefficient c.pt^*G, there is a stage i and a raw class t at that stage whose image under the canonical raw-to-higher-image section comparison, followed by higherDirectImageOverMap(c_i), equals the raw-to-higher-image section associated to z. The raw presheaves use the free module sheaf on U and single complexes in [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. This is only an assertion about raw classes on affine objects; it says nothing about arbitrary higher-image sections or sheaf colimits.

proof.text: Choose a small directed final presentation of I^op; the opposite presentation is initial and preserves the scheme limit. Base change to U. Qcqs structure morphisms become qcqs schemes over affine U, and affine transitions remain affine. Composition of inverse images identifies the pulled-back coefficient diagram with the constant diagram of the limit coefficient sheaf. Connectedness identifies its colimit with that sheaf.

Identify the raw derived-Hom groups with module cohomology of the base changes. Use injective module resolutions and their acyclicity for underlying abelian sections to compute the same cohomology in abelian sheaves. Apply complex continuity to degree-zero complexes, uniformly bounded below by zero. Surjectivity of the filtered abelian-group colimit produces a representative at a stage. Negative degrees have only zero classes, and a stage exists by cofilteredness.

The raw comparison is defined by derived adjunction followed by homology and evaluation at the free-sheaf generator. Expand the unit-counit definition of higherDirectImageOverMap. Naturality of the unit moves the class across pullback; the triangle identity cancels the counit. Pullback composition, its single-functor comparison, and the homology shift comparison give exactly the section associated to the pulled-back raw class. Apply this identity to the stage representative.
